data_model_notes: Jobs are stored as rows in the legacy public.campaigns table tagged payout_model='job'. jobDetailProvider maps a raw campaigns row into a job-shaped map exposing keys: title, description, category, payment_amount(<-payout_per_creator), max_slots(<-slots, 0=unlimited=>null), deadline, cover_image_url(<-cover_image), status, created_at, plus all original row keys. jobSlotCountProvider returns {filled:int}. campaignDetailProvider returns the raw campaigns row joined with users!brand_id(id,name,avatar_url) exposed under key 'users'; the CURRENT campaign_detail_screen.dart reads keys: title, cover_image_url, description, budget, per_creator_payout, platform, category, deadline(String), guidelines, min_followers, filled_slots, total_slots, users{name,avatar_url}. IMPORTANT: keep reading these EXACT keys (do not rename to DB column names) so nothing breaks; render conditionally when a key is absent/null. The live campaigns table is quirky: columns include id, brand_id, brandName(text NOT NULL no default), title, description(NOT NULL), category, budget(numeric), payout_per_creator(numeric), payout_model(text), slots(integer), cover_image(text), deadline(TEXT), status(text), created_at, createdAt, is_job(bool), plus many camelCase columns.
